name: Barceló Nura
description: The island's big design resort: a five-star in Biniancolla, next to Punta Prima, with 128 rooms — 45 with direct access to semi-private pools — three outdoor pools, a spa and architecture built to blend in: reclaimed water, solar thermal energy and natural materials. For those who want the resort format without giving up design.

practicalInfo.acceso: Biniancolla, Sant Lluís, next to Punta Prima.
practicalInfo.horario: Seasonal opening: check 2026 dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: 128 rooms (45 with semi-private pools), three pools, spa and gym, restaurants.
